tcn-sup.desc: generic supervised TCN: same body, focal loss only, no z_u (reference-style TCN)

lstm.desc: LSTM 2 x 128, same input layer, focal loss only, no z_u

iforest.desc: Isolation Forest (200 trees) on window summaries, fitted on nominal training windows (unsupervised)

rule.desc: D3 hand-written heuristic over the newest event (untrained)

tcn-d3.desc: Deliverable 3 TCN (L = 20, d = 50, 10 blocks), retrained on this data, focal loss, early stop on val PR-AUC

tcn-noz.desc: ablation: v3 TCN without the timer context z_u

tcn-noaux.desc: ablation: v3 TCN without the self-supervised heads

gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU, 6141 MiB, 610.47
